title: Data processing method based on isomorphic machine learning framework
assignee: Hangzhou Yikang Huilian Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Inefficiency in training machine learning models based on federal learning due to poor interaction between generated data across training nodes.
pse.solution_function: A data processing method facilitates interaction between training nodes by performing linear regression training of a machine learning model using characteristic data derived from input training data. The method updates local gradient information and encrypts intermediate data for secure data collaboration during the training process.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of training nodes (initiating node, participating node) and a forwarding node. Each training node processes characteristic data, performs linear regression, sends/receives gradient information, encrypts/decrypts intermediate data, and updates model weights.
pse.solution_implementation: Each training node processes input training data to obtain characteristic data, which is used for local linear regression training of the machine learning model. Gradient information is sent to the forwarding node, where it is distributed to other nodes. Local gradient information is updated and calculated. Intermediate data generated by training is encrypted using a hash encryption algorithm before being sent to the forwarding node. The forwarding node distributes encrypted intermediate data to each training node for calculation.
pse.effect: The method improves platform model training efficiency by enabling effective interaction between training nodes, particularly in privacy-protected data collaboration scenarios
